usage: 栗子糕 is a noun referring to a type of sweet dim sum made from chestnuts.
You can use 栗子糕 when ordering food in a restaurant.
栗子糕 is typically eaten as a dessert or snack.
The word 糕 means a kind of cake, so 栗子糕 literally means chestnut cake.
When talking about dim sum, 栗子糕 is a specific sweet dish you can mention.
